office_does: The Coroner investigates sudden, unexpected and unexplained deaths in Cowlitz County and determines cause and manner of death.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Coroner Dana M. Tucker (prefers Republican) is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Incumbent Cowlitz County Coroner (prefers Republican) with 13 years of investigative experience; the only candidate.
highlights: Says the office has improved investigative practices and collaboration with local agencies [S1]
